'''''Canistropsis billbergioides''''' is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the [[genus]] ''Canistropsis''. This species is [[Endemism|endemic]] to [[Brazil]].

Two forms may be recognized:<ref name=EOB>{{citation |mode=cs2 |last1=Gouda |first1=E.J. |last2=Butcher |first2=D. |last3=Gouda |first3=C.S. |date=2022 |title=''Canistropsis billbergioides'' forma ''azurea'' (E.Pereira & Leme) Leme |website=Encyclopaedia of Bromeliads |publisher=Utrecht University Botanic Gardens |url=https://bromeliad.nl/species/Canistropsis/billbergioides/forma/azurea |access-date=2022-11-13}}</ref>
*''Canistropsis billbergioides'' f. ''azurea''
*''Canistropsis billbergioides'' f. ''billbergioides''
